description: Use when someone wants to compare 2 to 4 rented homes or areas in England by postcode. Returns each postcode's check_address answer and area market figures, plus a side-by-side table of licence need, landlord register window, flood zone, conservation areas, Article 4 directions, average local rent and median sale price. Every field names its source, licence and dates; anything the sources cannot settle is unknown, never no. Read-only. Each postcode counts as one request against the rate limit. Information, not legal advice.

household.description: single: one household; small_hmo: 3-4 people from 2+ households; large_hmo: 5+ people from 2+ households

postcodes.description: Full postcodes of the rented properties, e.g. ["SE15 5BA", "SW6 1HS"]

name: compare_addresses
title: Compare rental addresses
